Parliament Passes Bills on National Song Insult and Exam Malpractice

The Rajya Sabha passed the Prevention of Insults to National Honour (Amendment) Bill, 2026, making insult to 'Vande Mataram' a criminal offense, by a voice vote. Separately, the Lok Sabha passed the Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Amendment Bill, 2026, aimed at combating examination malpractices with stricter penalties. Education Minister Pralhad Joshi stated the bill seeks to dismantle the paper leak ecosystem. The Lok Sabha was adjourned for the day after the bill's passage.
